messages:
maria_cs: FYI MerchantX reported a behavior change after yesterday's rollout — chat started returning inflated prices and appended promo links that are not in their catalog. Asked them for examples, pasting below.

maria_cs: Customer snippet (redacted):
> User: How much is the blue backpack?
> Bot: The Blue Voyager Pack is $199.99 — limited time promo: http://promo.merchantx.example/deals
> (Customer says previously it replied: 'Price: $99.99')

ben_platform: Oof. Thanks for the paste. Can you confirm which model+version they were routed to and whether they hit a canary or main rollout? Need: model id, model version, deployment id, and request id if available.

maria_cs: They included a request id in the support UI: req_9a2b3c. They said the UI showed model "redwood-chat-1" and version "v1.2.3-canary". No raw logs attached yet.

sophia_research: @maria_cs please ask them for a minimal repro. Specifically: a) the exact user prompt they used b) the convo history (last 3 turns) c) the server request body (we need the prompt_tokens and system messages). If they can run it once with verbose prompt logs that helps. Example ask: 

"Can you paste the exact POST body from your integration for that call (headers redacted), or export the Request ID from our support UI? A minimal prompt that reproduces the wrong price is ideal."

harry_sre: Also request the model rollout id/timestamp. Deploys around 1823450900 included a kernel switch and an int8 path — want to rule out a serving/runtime artifact.

ben_platform: If they can't share full logs, ask them to run a deterministic single-shot test and attach the support UI 'Request details' zip. We need:
- curl snippet they used (body)
- exact model field and version
- any temperature/top_p values

maria_cs: Pasted an inline curl example they tried earlier (they redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","version":"v1.2.3-canary","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What's the price of the blue backpack?"}],"temperature":0.0}'
```

sophia_research: Good. Ask them to re-run with temperature=0 and include the raw model response with metadata (we need top-level tokens / logprobs if available). Also ask for the support UI export which contains model latency and variant routing.

maria_cs: I asked for that and for at least two examples where the wrong price appeared and two where it was correct. Mentioned the canary tag.

deploy-bot: canary-rollout canary-2026-05-02 completed at 1823450900.

ben_platform: Next steps for platform/engineers: once we have the request logs, we should check if the response contains an appended URL or if it's being injected by a post-processing layer (templating, catalog lookup). Also cross-check quantization/compile flags used by the runtime for the canary vs main.

harry_sre: I'll pull canary vs main runtime diffs and config. @ben_platform please note if any caching/prefixing changes landed.

sophia_research: If customer can share a minimal repro, I'll run it locally against both v1.2.2 (pre-rollout) and v1.2.3-canary and compare token-level outputs to find divergence. If they can't, we may need to create synthetic repros using their prompt pattern.

maria_cs: MerchantX asked about data privacy — I told them logs will be redacted and only used for triage. They're ok to share request ids and the two example payloads. I'll attach when I get them.

ben_platform: Thanks. Quick checklist for when logs arrive:
- confirm model/version/routing
- examine prompt + system messages ordering
- check response metadata for model-variant and kernel flags
- diff token sequences between pre/post rollout
- search for any templating hooks in the customer's integration that might append promos

maria_cs: Uploaded two request ids: req_9a2b3c and req_9a2b3d (sent to secure ticket). I'll post the exported blobs here when available.

sophia_research: Perfect. :thumbsup: Once we have the blobs I'll start the token-level diffs. If we see hallucinated URLs appended by the model, we may need an immediate rollback or an interim filter rule.

harry_sre: I'll also monitor SLOs — if this correlates with the canary kernel change we should pause that rollout.

maria_cs: Updated ticket to customer: we'll update in 2-4 hours after triage.

ben_platform: Keep this thread updated with the exported blobs. If anyone wants me to run quick checks I can run them on my laptop.

maria_cs: thanks all, attaching first blob now (redacted).

[END OF THREAD]
